__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Azure Monitor managed Prometheus or any Prometheus data source.

description: AV/HPC Azure Managed Lustre dashboard: health, metadata triage, OST data path, storage capacity, client I/O, metadata performance, reliability, freshness, and inventory.

panels.title: Overview
panels.description: Compact fleet health summary: collection health, OST capacity pressure, metadata latency, and client disruption.

panels.title: Collector age
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful Managed Lustre collection. Zero reset timestamps are ignored.

targets.expr: time() - max(azure_managed_lustre_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="$job"} > 0)

panels.title: Collection errors
panels.description: Rate of failed Managed Lustre collection calls over five minutes.

targets.expr: sum(rate(azure_managed_lustre_collection_errors_total{job="$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: OST used max (aggregate if ostnum=all)
panels.description: Highest selected OST used percentage. In AMLFS aggregate-only environments this is ostnum="all", not a physical per-OST maximum. Write-heavy phases should stay below the safety boundary.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_ost_bytes_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"})

panels.title: MDT latency max (Azure Monitor sample)
panels.description: Worst selected MDT operation latency from Azure Monitor MDTClientLatency. This is a sampled aggregate/mean, not p95/p99 and not MDS CPU. Warning at 100 ms, serious at 500 ms, hang-risk at 1000 ms.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_latency_milliseconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})

panels.title: Evictions
panels.description: Sum of filesystem-level client eviction interval-total samples over the dashboard range.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_client_evictions{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Metadata triage
panels.description: Focused metadata-pressure summary: amplification, metadata work per client, MDT inode pressure, and MDT byte pressure.

panels.title: Amplification
panels.description: sum(MDTClientOps) / max(sum(ClientReadOps + ClientWriteOps), 1).

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_metadata_amplification_ratio{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

panels.title: MDT inode used (aggregate if mdtnum=all)
panels.description: Highest selected MDT file/inode usage. In AMLFS aggregate-only environments this is mdtnum="all", not a physical per-MDT maximum.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_mdt_files_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})

panels.title: MDT bytes used (aggregate if mdtnum=all)
panels.description: Highest selected MDT byte usage. In AMLFS aggregate-only environments this is mdtnum="all". Byte pressure is less common than inode pressure but still blocks metadata growth when exhausted.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_mdt_bytes_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})

panels.title: MDT ops per client
panels.description: Metadata operations per connected client. High values indicate metadata-heavy clients, directory scans, small-file storms, or cleanup/indexing jobs.

targets.expr: max(sum by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}) / on (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) clamp_min(max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"}), 1))

panels.title: Storage capacity
panels.description: FSx-style storage capacity view: data target usage and absolute free space, metadata byte usage, metadata inode usage, and provisioned size.

panels.title: OST used % (aggregate if ostnum=all)
panels.description: Top selected OST used percentages. In AMLFS aggregate-only environments this is an ostnum="all" filesystem aggregate, not physical per-OST imbalance. Warning at 75%, critical at 80%.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, ostnum) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_bytes_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: OST available (aggregate if ostnum=all)
panels.description: Absolute free space for selected OST series. In AMLFS aggregate-only environments this is ostnum="all" filesystem aggregate, not physical per-OST free space. Warning below 1 TiB, critical below 100 GiB. Used % alone hides absolute headroom on large targets.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, min by (filesystem_name, ostnum) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_bytes_available{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: MDT bytes used % (aggregate if mdtnum=all)
panels.description: Top selected MDT byte usage. In AMLFS aggregate-only environments this is mdtnum="all" filesystem aggregate. Warning at 75%, critical at 90%.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_bytes_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: MDT inode used % (aggregate if mdtnum=all)
panels.description: Top selected MDT inode/file usage. In AMLFS aggregate-only environments this is mdtnum="all" filesystem aggregate. Warning at 70%, critical at 85%.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_files_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: Provisioned TiB
panels.description: Total configured Azure Managed Lustre storage capacity across selected filesystems.

targets.expr: sum(azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_storage_capacity_tib{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

panels.title: Lowest OST free-space (per-series)
panels.description: Lowest selected OST free-space rows. This is only a true physical per-OST view when Azure Monitor exposes per-OST labels; with ostnum="all" it is the filesystem aggregate. Values below 1 TiB are warning, below 100 GiB are critical.

targets.expr: bottomk($top_n, max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, ostnum) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_bytes_available{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: OST series >75%
panels.description: Number of selected OST metric series above the data-capacity warning threshold. With ostnum="all" this counts the aggregate filesystem series, not physical OST count.

targets.expr: count(max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, ostnum) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_bytes_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}) > 75) or vector(0)

panels.title: MDT series >70% inode
panels.description: Number of selected MDT metric series above the inode warning threshold. With mdtnum="all" this counts the aggregate filesystem series, not physical MDT count.

targets.expr: count(max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_files_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}) > 70) or vector(0)

panels.title: OST data path
panels.description: Dedicated Lustre data-path view for AV workloads: OST operation latency, OST operation volume, and connected-client distribution. Keep this alongside metadata panels because large sensor logs, write-heavy phases, and striping issues are OST-bound.

panels.title: OST latency by operation
panels.description: Top selected OST operation latencies by filesystem, OST, and operation. Use this to distinguish data-path latency from MDT metadata latency.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, ostnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_client_latency_milliseconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: OST ops by operation
panels.description: Top selected OST operation counts by filesystem, OST, and operation.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, ostnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_client_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: OST connected clients
panels.description: Connected client exports seen by OSTs. Per-OST variance can indicate failover, eviction, routing imbalance, or future per-OST telemetry differences.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, ostnum) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: OST latency incidents now
panels.description: Only shows current OST operation latency above 100 ms. Empty means no current OST data-path latency issue above the warning threshold.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, ostnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_client_latency_milliseconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}) > 100)

panels.title: Client I/O
panels.description: Client-facing workload view: throughput, data operations, metadata operations per client, and connected clients.

panels.title: Read/write throughput
panels.description: Client data transfer rate grouped by filesystem.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, sum by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_client_read_throughput_bytes_per_second{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

topk($top_n, sum by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_client_write_throughput_bytes_per_second{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: Read/write ops
panels.description: Client read and write operation counts grouped by filesystem.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, sum by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_client_read_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

topk($top_n, sum by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_client_write_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: MDT ops/client trend
panels.description: sum(MDTClientOps) divided by derived filesystem connected clients. Highlights metadata-storm phases.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, sum by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}) / on (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) clamp_min(max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"}), 1))

panels.title: Connected clients
panels.description: Derived per-filesystem client counts. Sudden changes can correlate with evictions, failover, or workload phase changes.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

panels.title: Metadata amplification
panels.description: Top filesystems by derived metadata amplification ratio over time.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_metadata_amplification_ratio{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"}))

panels.title: Metadata performance
panels.description: FSx-style metadata category: MDT latency, MDT operation volume, and top operation tables for customer troubleshooting.

panels.title: MDT latency by operation
panels.description: Top selected MDT operation latencies by filesystem and operation. Use the Operation variable to focus on sync, getattr/statfs, rename, setattr, and other Azure Monitor operation labels. If Operation only contains all, Azure Monitor is returning aggregate-only samples.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_latency_milliseconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum", operation=~"$operation"}))

panels.title: MDT ops by operation
panels.description: Top selected MDT operation counts by filesystem and operation. Mirrors Azure Monitor's Client MDT Ops split by Operation when that dimension is present.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum", operation=~"$operation"}))

panels.title: MDT latency incidents now
panels.description: Only shows current MDT operation latency above 100 ms for the selected Operation values. Empty means no current MDT latency issue above the warning threshold.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, mdtnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_latency_milliseconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum", operation=~"$operation"}) > 100)

panels.title: Reliability and freshness
panels.description: Client disruption, HSM/data-repository pressure, and telemetry quality.

panels.title: Client evictions
panels.description: Filesystem-level client eviction interval-total samples. Non-zero values indicate reconnect/disruption risk.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_client_evictions{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"}))

panels.title: HSM in-flight requests
panels.description: HSM backlog by filesystem and MDT. Sustained growth can indicate archive/restore backpressure.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_hsm_current_requests{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))
vector($hsm_inflight_warn)

panels.title: HSM action errors
panels.description: HSM action failures by filesystem and MDT. Any non-zero value should be investigated when HSM is enabled.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_hsm_action_errors{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: Filesystem sample age
panels.description: Derived Azure Monitor sample age by filesystem. Stale samples can make capacity and latency panels misleading.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_sample_max_age_seconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"}))

panels.title: Collection duration
panels.description: Duration of the most recent Managed Lustre collection attempt.

targets.expr: azure_managed_lustre_collection_duration_seconds{job="$job"}

panels.title: Inventory
panels.description: Discovered Lustre filesystem identity, with inventory metrics first and OST/MDT sample-series fallback for older deployments.

panels.title: Discovered Lustre filesystems
panels.description: Discovered Azure Managed Lustre filesystems from inventory metrics, with fallback to OST/MDT sample series for older deployments. SKU tier is marked unknown when only metric-series fallback data is available.

targets.expr: max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, sku_tier) (azure_managed_lustre_discovered_filesystem_info) or max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, sku_tier) (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_info) or label_replace((max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) list.name: ostnum
list.label: OST (hidden: Azure Monitor exposes aggregate only)

list.name: mdtnum
list.label: MDT (hidden: Azure Monitor exposes aggregate only)

list.name: operation
list.label: MDT operation

query.query: label_values(azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", location=~"$location", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}, operation)

list.definition: label_values(azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", location=~"$location", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}, operation)

title: Azure Managed Lustre Key Metrics
